notes:
CRM notes (shorthand) - mid-market SaaS; product analytics + CX use cases. Ran 30-day Hosted API trial (Nov-Feb) focused on chat + embedding pipelines.
- Trial summary: onboarding smooth, SDKs used by 3 engs and 1 PM. Token spend ~1.2M tokens/mo during trial credits. Saw steady 1–1.5 QPS baseline; peak traffic during morning digest spikes ~3.8 QPS.
- Latency targets: 95th <= 150ms for short-turn chat; acceptable up to 300ms for long context summaries. Customer: "need consistent p95 under load or we'll see CSAT drop."
- Workload breakdown observed during trial: avg request = prompt 80 tokens + completion 420 tokens => ~500 tokens/session. Token mix: ~60% short (<512), 30% mid (512-2048), 10% long (>2048).
- Concurrency observed: average concurrency 6, 95th concurrency ~14, peak concurrent bursts to 20 during campaigns.
- POC specifics: implemented caching for FAQ embed recall (reduced token repeat by ~18%), vectordb + Redwood embeddings latency measured 40-60ms median.
- Security: needs SSO/SAML + KMS integration for key wrapping; audit log retention 13 months; data isolation for EU customers (may require region routing).
- Pricing sensitivity: procurement team comfortable with committed spend if predictable unit pricing and clear autoscale burst policy. Interested in 12–24 month reserved capacity discount.
- Tech ask (from infra lead): recommended Dedicated nodes that can sustain 4 QPS steady with headroom for 8 QPS bursts; want warm KV cache preloaded daily.
- Quote from CTO on 2026-03-02 call: "Hosted trial exceeded perf expectations — next step is a Dedicated plan that doesn't surprise our monthly bill."
- Next milestones: internal budget review (Mar 15), legal security questionnaire due (Mar 22), Dedicated sizing + commercial proposal (target Mar 31).
- Open questions: EU data residency mapping, exact SLA wording, GPU family recommendation (A100 vs H100), autoscale cost model for burst traffic.
- Internal AE notes: good fit for Redwood Dedicated + Optimize recommendations; strong chance to upsell observability retention.
dedicated_capacity_summary: Suggested Dedicated sizing based on trial telemetry: baseline target throughput 1.5 QPS steady, capacity target 4 QPS steady with burst to 8 QPS. Concurrency planning: sustain 16 concurrent streams at p95. Token mix leads to average token/sec ~ 500 tokens/request * 1.5 req/sec = 750 tokens/sec baseline (~2.7M tokens/day). Recommend initial reserved pool = 4 x H100-equivalent GPUs (or 6 x A100-equivalent if H100 not available) with autoscale + 2 burst nodes. KV cache RAM 320GB total, NVMe for large embeddings cache. Include cost cushion for longer-context jobs (10% of traffic).
